items.title: Iran faces 'greatest financial offensive ever', says US treasury secretary
items.description: Scott Bessent says the US will sever all economic ties with the country and that any nation partnering with Iran financially will also be isolated.

items.title: UK PM Burnham vows support for Ukraine despite 'outrageous threats' from Russia
items.description: It comes after Moscow warned of "consequences" over the reported use of British drones by Ukraine.

items.title: Russia's second-biggest online retailer targeted in Ukrainian strikes
items.description: Ozon says its warehouses across southern Russia, including in Dagestan and Krasnodar, were hit in the overnight strikes.

items.title: Israel warns of 'forceful' response to kites flown from Gaza
items.description: Hamas says the kites found in Israeli border communities in recent days were launched by children in Gaza.

items.title: King of Norway's health has worsened, palace says
items.description: Norway's King Harald remains in hospital receiving antibiotics for a bloodstream bacterial infection.

items.title: Outrage in Nepal over rape and murder of three-year-old girl
items.description: There have been protests since the girl was found dead last week, three days after she went missing.

items.title: Nearly three million Teslas recalled in China over hidden door handles
items.description: Other brands affected by the recall include Chinese carmakers XPeng, Xiaomi and Geely.

items.title: Sonya Massey's killer Sean Grayson dies in US prison
items.description: The former police officer, whose crime reignited the debate about US police brutality, was undergoing treatment for cancer.

items.title: Access to Zambian courts prevented as election petition deadline looms
items.description: Preparations for President Hakainde Hichilema's second inauguration appear to be continuing.

items.title: Four arrested over suspected poisoning of elephants in Kenya
items.description: An investigation is looking into whether the deaths were caused by pesticides sprayed on tomato crops.

items.title: China probes use of formaldehyde to keep cabbages fresh
items.description: Using the carcinogen to preserve food is prohibited in China, the world's largest producer of cabbages.

items.title: New Zealand to introduce bill for under-16s social media ban
items.description: The government faces opposition to its proposals from MPs who believe a ban will not work.
